lines.en: I walk around your bed.
My steps press into the floorboards.
I move to the other side of the bed.
The curtain sways where I brushed it.
I move along the wall of your room.
I go to the window and stand a while.
I edge slowly along the bedside.
One floorboard creaks when stepped on.
I try to avoid that board.
I pause at the doorway.
I walk back to your pillow's side.
I stand at the bedside and watch you.
You're sleeping very deeply.
I rest my hand on the bed's edge.
The moonlight outside is thin.
Your blanket has slipped a little.
Your breathing slows when you sleep.
I don't dare make any sound.
I lean down by your pillow.
Your brow moved once.
I quickly stepped back half a pace.
Your hand lies outside the blanket.
I've turned the wick down low.
You opened your eyes and saw me.

lines.zh: 你睡着时我一直在这里。
lines.en: I've been here the whole time you slept.
My face is right beside yours.
Were you about to rise?
You shouldn't have woken so soon.
Why not sleep a little longer?
Your breathing hasn't steadied yet.
I hadn't meant to touch you.
Just watching you was enough for me.
Your eyes are still open.
I draw back a little, slowly.

lines.zh: 你看不见我心里想什么。
lines.en: You can't see what I'm thinking.
You needn't sit up.
The pillow is still warm.
Were you dreaming just now?
Your hands are cold as ice.
I counted as far as a thousand.
You look very uneasy.
I'm only standing at the foot of your bed.

lines.zh: 我的肩上被打开一道口。
lines.en: A gash has opened on my shoulder.
I slipped back half a step.
I made no sound.
My outline blurred for a moment.
I press the place that was struck.
The room is still as quiet as before.
I've come back toward the bed.

lines.zh: 你的手穿过了我的影子。
lines.en: Your hand passed straight through my shadow.
I only stepped back.
I'm still here, watching you.
I've no use for this thing.
Did you have this while you slept?
That's for your own use.
Save your bread for tomorrow.
Put it back; don't wake anything.
You'll have to rely on yourself.
I'll wait for you to sleep again.
Holding it up does you no good.
You're still sleepy.
I don't see how that helps.
You bumped into my chest.
I didn't move, like a wall.
You were pushed back to the bed.
The bed frame knocked.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀碰到了我的手臂。
lines.en: Your shoulder touched my arm.
I catch you gently.
The window rattled.
You stepped onto my foot.
Don't wake anyone in the house.
I only watch you while you sleep.
Pull the blanket up.
There's a bed between us.
You're quietest when you sleep.
I'm not worth your trust.
Staying here is enough for me.
Don't let your eyes open again.
I'll keep watch, always.
Let it stay like this until dawn.
I pick up your fallen blanket.
You should keep this thing.
It rolled off the head of the bed.
I turned it over in my hand.
It carries a little of your warmth.
I set it back in place.
This thing rattles when moved.
I keep it closed in my palm.
I tuck it back beside your hand.
You turned over just now.
You turned your face this way.
I'm half a foot from your face.
Your hand has slipped off the bed.
You're in bed; I'm at the bedside.
Your breathing has grown rough.
I'm waiting for you to sleep deeper.
Moonlight falls on your neck.
I've lifted my hand.
Your eyes are shut tightly.
I've stopped halfway.
You've suddenly gone still.
I let my hand drop again.
This time I watch for longer.
I should be in your dreams.
Dawn is coming on.
You're asleep in the middle of the bed.
I haven't moved away at all.
I've drawn the curtain a little tighter.
There's no light at all in your room.
I put your hand back under the blanket.
I sat by the bed half the night.
I've finished counting your breaths.
You called out in your sleep.
There's sweat on your forehead.
I reached out and pulled back.
There's a little light outside now.
Your eyes moved.
You're about to wake.
I need to move faster.
Your hand has clutched the blanket.
You've opened your eyes.
It is far too late now.
I've been here the whole while.
I've pinned your wrist.
My knee presses down the blanket.
Your body won't move.
That was very gentle.
I push your hand back to the bed.
You're still trying to sit up.
The bed creaks under my hand.
I press you back down.
This time you closed your eyes.
I slowly lean down.
You're trembling under my hand.
I pull the blanket to your shoulders.
Just stay in this position.
Your hand has gone limp.
I'm pleased with this.
I appeared after you fell asleep.
Only a little moonlight is left in the room.
I'm standing at the foot of the bed.
Your blanket rises and falls.
I move slowly toward the bedside.
The floor swallows my sound.
I ease the door shut.
The wind outside has died.
I've crept a little nearer.
You're nearly asleep.
I hear you talking in your sleep.
I lean down to look at you.
You really are deeply asleep.
I'll keep watch until dawn.
Nothing stirs in the room.
You turn over and back again.
A single step parts us.

lines.zh: 火光让我的影子动了一下。
lines.en: The firelight made my shadow move.
I came down off the beam.

lines.zh: 水一直漫到了我的胸口。
lines.en: Water rose all the way to my chest.
The blast tore the window open.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过了我的耳朵。
lines.en: An arrow grazed my ear.

lines.zh: 那道光把整间屋子照亮了。
lines.en: That light lit up the whole room.

lines.zh: 我早就没有这些需要了。
lines.en: I've long since lost such needs.
The lightning bleached the bed white.
There's nothing underneath.
